. The company added €109m in extra debt last year, taking total borrowings to €392.5m, while losses widened to €111.3m, according to accounts reported by

The robots will initially operate in Canary Wharf, Milton Keynes, Leeds, Stockton‑on‑Tees and Nottingham, with Deliveroo also in talks with more councils and the Department for Transport to expand the rollout.
